reason: My buyers know me, my prices and my trucks; they buy from people they have shaken hands with at a fair, not from a cold email out of a warmed-up domain. I might take the free list of 15 companies just to see it, but I am not paying 1,500 euro to an agency I found on LinkedIn among the three or four that pitch me every week.
objection: In wholesale a meeting is not a deal. Even if they get me five calls with some purchasing manager, those people get cold messages too, and I doubt anyone signs a supply contract because a stranger wrote to them. 45 meetings for a logistics company tells me nothing about distribution.
would_change_my_mind: Talking on the phone with a past client who is a distributor like me, in a market I care about, who tells me the meetings turned into actual orders, not just calls.
